seoul-gangwon-mountain-run.title: Seoul · Gangwon Mountain Run
seoul-gangwon-mountain-run.slogan: A long mountain-and-coast day for early starts.
seoul-gangwon-mountain-run.story: A long mountain-and-coast day for early starts. A 390 km loop that starts and ends near Hongch’ŏn, about 7 h 30 of riding. The stops in between: Gangneung coast and Odaesan  roads. Daegwallyeong high road is the high point. It tops out at about 800 m. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 29 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
